{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats condemn the Trump Administration's discriminatory actions against the LGBTQ+ community, including regulations allowing doctors, hospitals, and insurance companies to discriminate against patients based on their sexual orientation or gender identity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reverse rulemaking and restore nondiscrimination protections for LGBTQ+ people and people living with HIV/AIDS in health insurance, including coverage of all medically necessary care for gender transition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take action to guarantee that LGBTQ+ people and those living with HIV/AIDS have full access to needed health care and resources.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will require that federal health plans provide coverage for HIV/AIDS testing and treatment and HIV prevention medications like PrEP and PEP, gender confirmation surgery, and hormone therapy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support increased community HIV prevention and testing programs which target Latino, Black, Asian American and Pacific Islander, Native American, and other at-risk communities to address the increases of HIV.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will recommit the federal government to ending the HIV/AIDS epidemic by 2025.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are proud that the Obama-Biden Administration lifted the discriminatory lifetime ban on blood donation by healthy gay and bisexual Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to ensure blood donation regulations are based on science, not fiction or stigma.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to ensure no American, when seeking to donate blood, will face more stringent limitations than any other simply because of who they are.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
